units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 11) specialized organization: a legal entity engaged by a contracting authority in accordance with Article 40 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 12) federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system: a federal executive body authorized to develop state policy and provide regulatory legal regulation in procurement;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 13) procurement control body: a federal executive body, executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, local self-government body of a municipal district, local self-government body of a municipal okrug, or local self-government body of an urban okrug, empowered to exercise procurement control; and also the federal executive body authorized to exercise control (supervision) over the state defence order and over procurement of goods, works and services to meet federal needs that are outside the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret (hereinafter, the state defence order control body);
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 14) executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation regulating the contractual procurement system: an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorized to ensure, in cooperation with the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system, implementation of state policy on procurement to meet the needs of that constituent entity, to organize monitoring of procurement to meet those needs, and to provide methodological support for the activities of contracting authorities conducting procurement to meet those needs;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 15) expert or expert organization: an individual, including an individual entrepreneur, possessing specialist knowledge, experience and qualifications in science, technology, art or a craft, or a legal entity whose employees must possess such knowledge, experience and qualifications, that, on the basis of a contract, studies and evaluates the subject of an expert examination and prepares expert opinions on questions raised by a contracting authority or procurement participant in the cases provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 16) aggregate annual procurement volume: the total funding approved for the relevant financial year for procurement by a contracting authority under this Federal Law, including payment under contracts concluded before the start of that financial year and payable during that financial year;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 17) electronic platform: a website on the Internet information and telecommunications network that meets the requirements established under points 1 and 2 of part 2 of Article 24.1 of this Federal Law, on which competitive methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers) are conducted electronically, except closed electronic methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers), as well as procurement conducted under part 12 of Article 93 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 18) electronic platform operator: a non-public business company in which foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities hold no more than twenty-five percent of the participatory interests (shares) in its charter capital, which owns an electronic platform, including the software and hardware required for its operation, ensures its operation, meets the requirements established under points 1 and 2 of part 2 of Article 24.1 of this Federal Law, and is included in the list of electronic platform operators approved by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 19) specialized electronic platform: an information system meeting the requirements established under points 1 and 3 of part 2 of Article 24.1 of this Federal Law, which is accessed through secure communications channels and on which closed competitive methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers) are conducted electronically;
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 20) specialized electronic platform operator: a Russian legal entity that owns a specialized electronic platform, including the software and hardware required for its operation, ensures its operation, meets the requirements established under points 1 and 3 of part 2 of Article 24.1 of this Federal Law, and is included in the list of specialized electronic platform operators approved by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 20 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 2. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1. To provide information support for the contractual procurement system, a unified information system shall be established and maintained. Its interaction with other information systems in accordance with part 2 of this Article shall ensure:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1) the generation, processing, storage and provision of data, including by automated means, to participants in the contractual procurement system within the relations specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2) verification of the consistency of information on procurement identification codes and that the amount of funding for the relevant procurement is not exceeded, as contained in procurement schedules (hereinafter also, schedules), procurement notices, records of the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers), and the terms of draft contracts sent under this Federal Law through the unified information system to procurement participants with whom contracts are to be concluded;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3) the use of an enhanced qualified electronic signature (hereinafter, an enhanced electronic signature) to sign electronic documents provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4) Repealed from 1 July 2018. — Federal Law of 31.12.2017 No. 504-FZ.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the rules for operation of the unified information system and for provision of information and documents from it; requirements for its technological and linguistic tools, including requirements for automating the collection and processing of information in it; and the rules for information exchange between the unified information system and other information systems, including those for management of state and municipal finances.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3. The unified information system shall contain:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1) Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2) schedules;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3) information on the implementation of schedules;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4) Repealed from 1 January 2025. — Federal Law of 08.08.2024 No. 318-FZ;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 5) information on procurement provided for by this Federal Law and on contract performance;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 6) the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 6.1) the unified register of procurement participants;
units.label: Point 6.1 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 7) the register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers);
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 8) the library of standard contract terms;
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 9) the register of independent guarantees;
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 10) the register of complaints, scheduled and unscheduled inspections, their results and orders issued;
units.label: Point 10 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 10.1) the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is being established, modernized or mastered, and of sole providers of services delivered using property (immovable property, or immovable and movable property technologically interconnected) that is being created or reconstructed;
units.label: Point 10.1 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 11) the list of international financial organizations established under international treaties to which the Russian Federation is a party, and of international financial organizations with which the Russian Federation has concluded international treaties;
units.label: Point 11 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 12) the results of procurement monitoring, procurement audit and procurement control;
units.label: Point 12 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 13) the reports of contracting authorities provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 13 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 14) the catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs;
units.label: Point 14 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 15) regulatory legal acts governing the relations specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 15 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 16) information on prevailing market prices of goods, works and services procured to meet state and municipal needs, and on requests for prices of goods, works and services published by contracting authorities under part 5 of Article 22 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 16 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 17) other information and documents whose generation and publication in the unified information system are provided for by this Federal Law, Federal Law of 18 July 2011 No. 223-FZ “On Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities”, and other regulatory legal acts adopted in accordance with them.
units.label: Point 17 Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4. The information specified in part 3 of this Article shall be published on the official website, unless otherwise provided in accordance with this Federal Law. Information published on the official website shall be publicly accessible and provided free of charge. Information constituting a state secret shall not be published in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 5. Consent of the personal data subject to processing of personal data contained in information and documents provided for by this Federal Law is not required where the data are processed for the purposes provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 6. The Government of the Russian Federation shall designate one or more federal executive bodies responsible for developing functional requirements for the unified information system; establishing, developing, maintaining and servicing it; and establishing the procedure for registration in it of participants in the contractual procurement system, other than procurement participants, and the procedure for using it.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 7. Constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal entities may create regional and municipal procurement information systems integrated with the unified information system.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 8. Uniform requirements for regional and municipal procurement information systems shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 9. The procedures for operating and using regional and municipal procurement information systems shall be established by acts of the highest executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and of local administrations, respectively.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 10. Integration of the information systems specified in part 7 of this Article and electronic platforms with the unified information system shall be achieved through:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1) exchange of electronic documents and information when those systems and electronic platforms interact with the unified information system, ensuring guaranteed transmission to the unified information system, with signing and publication in it, of electronic documents and information provided for by this Federal Law, including through the regional information systems specified in part 7 of this Article. Periods established by this Federal Law for publication of electronic documents and information in the unified information system shall be calculated from the time of their publication in the unified information system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2) use of the unified information system’s databases by those information systems and electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3) establishment of uniform technological and linguistic requirements for information processed in those systems and on electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4) publication of procurement information on the official website.
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 11. Establishing procurement information systems that are not integrated with the unified information system is prohibited.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 12. If information specified in points 1–15 of part 3 of this Article and published in the unified information system differs from information published in other procurement information systems, the information published in the unified information system shall prevail.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 13. A state information system shall be established to monitor and record actions and omissions of participants in the contractual procurement system in the unified information system and on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. That state system must ensure, among other things:
units.label: Part 13 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1) monitoring of the availability (operability) of the unified information system, electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms, and storage of information on that availability (operability);
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2) real-time recording, including video recording, of actions and omissions of participants in the contractual procurement system in the unified information system and on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3) storage of information on actions and omissions of participants in the contractual procurement system in the unified information system and on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms, including information on electronic documents generated by participants in the contractual procurement system and signed with an enhanced electronic signature, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 3 Part 13 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 14. For the operation of the state information system specified in part 13 of this Article, the Government of the Russian Federation shall:
units.label: Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1) designate the federal executive body authorized to ensure its operation and development;
units.label: Point 1 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2) establish the procedure for monitoring the availability (operability) of the unified information system, electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 2 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3) establish the procedure for real-time recording, including video recording, of actions and omissions of participants in the contractual procurement system in the unified information system and on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 3 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4) establish requirements for its operation and the procedures for generating, storing and using the information it contains, including:
units.label: Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: а) requirements for the technological and linguistic tools supporting the collection, processing, storage and use of information contained in that system;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: б) requirements for information technology interaction between that system and other information systems, including the unified information system, electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: в) requirements for the procedure and periods for storage of information contained in that system, and the procedure for providing that information;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: г) the rights and obligations of persons receiving information contained in that system;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4
